inputs.units: normalized; magnetic moment m*v^2/B; theta=kBT/m; U=kappa exp(-r/lambda)/r
inputs.zero_expectation_proof: For fixed b,u,p, transform phi to pi-phi modulo2pi and z to -z. Radius and phase sine are unchanged while cosine changes sign. Symmetric Gauss-Legendre nodes preserve this oddness exactly apart from floating-point error. Both central phase interval around pi/2 and its wrapped complement are invariant under the phase involution, so each stratum control expectation is exactly zero. The phase-independent gap mask preserves zero expectation.
inputs.estimator: signed mean=sum physical incoming weights*(nonlinear mean-c_B); second, cross and spatial moments unchanged
inputs.mask_scope: g=b-p/Omega>=.3 uses the fixed first-Born control; all other physical states keep original nonlinear mean and their original probability
inputs.design: coefficient one, gap .3, control L24 and order1024 frozen from historical-only pilot; order2048 is fixed estimator sensitivity, not outcome-dependent tuning
inputs.stability_scope: Both finite Gauss-Legendre controls have exactly zero phase expectation; their difference measures empirical estimator sensitivity, not physical quadrature bias.
inputs.boundary_scope: Identical control with Lcontrol24 used for every trajectory endpoint plane; paired endpoint differences are unchanged.
inputs.variance_scope: Within-cell variance ratios and four-replica spreads are descriptive empirical comparisons, not confidence intervals.
inputs.acceptance: recompute all original fixed full-domain sample, replica, partition, boundary, trajectory and integrity gates with controlled signed mean; all case order1024-to2048 scaled mean changes <=1%; preserve raw original failures
inputs.stop_rule: fixed saved states, controls and orders; no new ODE, adaptive coefficient, failure clipping or probability reweighting
inputs.scope: one bounded incident domain; analytically equivalent integrated signed mean; no complete plasma coefficient, collision closure or lifetime
